name: Emma Navarro
intro: Emma Navarro is an American from Charleston, South Carolina. She was born right here in New York City! She is famous for staying calm and never giving up.
story: Emma started tennis at age four at a playground in Charleston. Sometimes she rode a RipStik board to practice! In college she won the national title in her first year. In 2024 she made the final four here. On Friday she beat the No. 7 seed, a top-ranked player.

funFacts.text: Her family dog is a Bernedoodle named Marti. Marti even visits the tennis court!
Her high school teammates called her the bullet.
She has two big brothers and a little sister. Her sister plays college tennis.
She was born in New York City. Her family moved to Charleston when she was little.
She won the college national championship in her very first year at Virginia.
She has driven a real Formula One race car. She plays golf for fun too.
Her sister says Emma is the funniest one in the family. At school she was the class clown.

watchFor: Watch every ball come back, because fans call her a human backboard!
